summary: BORTHEN ENTREPRENØR AS (org. no. 937 042 051) is a private limited company (AS) based in Enebakk, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-01-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 41.000 (Oppføring av bygninger). CEO: Vidar Krogsæter; board chair: Tom Willy Borthen; auditor: BDO AS.
